# Rahul Singh Shekhawat

Rahul Singh Shekhawat is a Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer based in Mumbai, India, who builds AI-powered SaaS products on AWS and works remotely with clients worldwide.

## Summary
- Full-stack web development with Node.js, React, Next.js, and TypeScript
- AWS cloud architecture (Lambda, EC2, S3, Route 53, DynamoDB) and serverless backends
- AI integrations and LLM-powered features for SaaS products
- End-to-end SaaS builds, from MVP to production, plus project work on existing applications
- Performance, SEO, and cloud-migration improvements for existing apps
